verdict.rationale: Foreloop's agent reads a submission, fills in an intention and proposes tasks. Nothing runs until a person approves the contract, and agents only claim approved tasks before opening PRs (docs-7, docs-35, docs-3, docs-37). The intention has editable deliverables, so the developer can revise the plan before approving (docs-30). Missing for 10: evidence that the approved contract includes a code-level implementation plan (files or approach) rather than task-level deliverables, detail on what the review UI shows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
